title: Phone Pass
brief: The Task Force is raiding Balo Market. Get Amaka's stock out before they reach her stall, then get out yourself.
standout: On foot through the raid, then out of the market on the back of Tunde's okada.

lines: Second night on Baba Driver's danfo.
Under the back seat: a bag. One million naira. Shina's levy money.
Mama's N350,000 debt is paid tonight, with Shina's own cash.

objectives.text: Pack the phones off the stall

say.speaker: Balo Market
lines: Trader: Task Force! Task Force don enter market o!
Amaka: Not my screens. Not today.
Amaka: Tunde, if you dey near Balo, come now. Bring that okada.

objectives.text: Get out through the back of the market
objectives.sub: Crouch (X) to stay small. They chase what they see.

onDone.toast: Tunde don show with the okada!

objectives.sub: Ride. Stay out of their sight until the stars go.
When the market is quiet again

sayDone.speaker: The roof over Amaka's stall
lines: Amaka: I always knew you'd be somebody, Tunde. Even when you no know.
